P301.sql: SELECT c.customer_id,c.first_name,c.email FROM customer c JOIN store s ON s.store_id=c.store_id JOIN address a ON a.address_id=s.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id=a.city_id WHERE ci.city='London'

P302.sql: SELECT film_id,title FROM film WHERE rental_duration BETWEEN 90 AND 110 ORDER BY replacement_cost ASC,film_id ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT film_id,title FROM film WHERE length BETWEEN 90 AND 110 ORDER BY replacement_cost DESC,film_id ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT film_id,title FROM film WHERE length BETWEEN 90 AND 110 ORDER BY replacement_cost ASC,film_id ASC

P303.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_date,'%m'),COUNT(*) FROM payment GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_date,'%m')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_date,'%Y-%m'),COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(payment_date)) FROM payment GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_date,'%Y-%m')

P304.sql: SELECT i.store_id,ROUND(AVG(p.amount),4) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id=p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id

SELECT store_id,ROUND(AVG(customer_mean),4) FROM (SELECT c.store_id,c.customer_id,AVG(p.amount) customer_mean FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.store_id) t GROUP BY store_id

P305.sql: SELECT a.actor_id,COUNT(*) FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id=a.actor_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id=fa.film_id WHERE f.rating='G' GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC,a.actor_id ASC

SELECT a.actor_id,COUNT(fa.film_id) FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id=a.actor_id LEFT JOIN film f ON f.film_id=fa.film_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY COUNT(fa.film_id) ASC,a.actor_id ASC

SELECT a.actor_id,COUNT(CASE WHEN f.rating='G' THEN fa.film_id END) FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id=a.actor_id LEFT JOIN film f ON f.film_id=fa.film_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY COUNT(CASE WHEN f.rating='G' THEN fa.film_id END) DESC,a.actor_id ASC

P311.sql: SELECT f.film_id,f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id=f.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id=i.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_date<='2005-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY f.film_id HAVING SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,r.rental_date,r.return_date)-CAST(f.rental_duration AS SIGNED),0),0))>0 ORDER BY SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,r.rental_date,r.return_date)-CAST(f.rental_duration AS SIGNED),0),0)) DESC,f.film_id ASC LIMIT 3
